description: This Java source file defines an immutable class AclEnforcerCacheLoader, which implements asynchronous cache loading for ACL enforcers based on entity IDs and resource types. It interacts with an actor-based shard proxy to retrieve access control information for 'things', managing cache entries with revision tracking and handling various response scenarios including missing or inaccessible data.

classes.name: AclEnforcerCacheLoader
classes.description: An asynchronous cache loader that fetches EntityIdWithResourceType keys and loads corresponding cache entries containing Enforcers for access control. It communicates with an actor shard proxy to retrieve 'things' with ACL data, processing responses to update or invalidate cache entries based on the presence or absence of access control lists.

methods.name: AclEnforcerCacheLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache loader with a specified timeout and shard proxy actor reference. Sets up command creation and response transformation functions for cache loading.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous loading of cache entries for a given EntityIdWithResourceType, using the delegate loader.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from the 'sudoRetrieveThing' command. Extracts ACL data and the revision number from a Thing object to create a cache entry, handling missing or inaccessible 'things'.

methods.name: badThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a supplier for an IllegalStateException with a custom message, used for handling unexpected response types.
